Title: Ishaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anita - 38 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Naira - 10 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Aditya - 11 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
5. Ananya - 8 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Anita, Naira and Aditya stand near him.]

Naira: "What lovely weather!"

[Ishaan jumps with joy.]

Ishaan (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ishaan climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Naira: "Aditya, listen!"

[Ishaan hides behind the tree.]

Naira: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The classroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the classroom. Anita and Ananya stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Ishaan raises his hand to answer.]

Ishaan: "How beautiful!"

[Ishaan writes on the blackboard.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

[Ishaan reads his book at his desk.]

Ishaan (gently): "One more time!"

[Ishaan yawns in the class.]

Anita: "That was such a fun day!"
